title: Charge Review Worksheet for Non-Covered Item Charges, Insulin Pump Program
content:
A billing correction on an Insulin Pump Program reverses the part of the program's largest non-covered item charge that the program's terms do not let the charge carry, worked out as follows.

## A. The charge and its line

- **Charge under review.** The program's non-covered item charge with the largest amount; its shipment is the line it bills, that line's grant is the authorization grant it drew on, the line's written order is the order that grant rests on, and the line's denial is the claim denial answering the original claim for that shipment.
- **Open amount.** The charge's amount less the credits already set against it. The credits set against the charge are the billing corrections and hardship waivers already posted against it.

## B. Price and units

- **Cash price per unit** of the reviewed line's item:

| Item | Cash price per unit |
|---|---|
| A4225 cartridge | $6.85 |
| A4232 reservoir | $7.10 |
| A4224 infusion-set supply | $38.40 |
| A4239 sensor allowance | $395.00 |
| E0784 pump, Tandem t:slim X2 | $6295.00 |
| E0784 pump, Tandem Mobi | $4995.00 |
| E0784 pump, MiniMed 780G | $7350.00 |
| E0784 pump, Beta Bionics iLet | $5250.00 |

For an E0784 line the price is that of the pump model on the program.

- **Covered rate.** The standard covered rate for the reviewed line is the tier's reservoirs per 30 days.
- **Denied units.** The reviewed line's denied units follow the denial answering its original claim: where a CO-151 denial answers it, they are its units less the covered rate times its supply days divided by 30, never below zero; where a PR-204 denial answers it, or a CO-197 denial does and the grant the line drew on did not cover its ship date, its valid-from date being later or its valid-through date earlier than the ship date, so that the denial is not appealed, every unit of the line is denied; otherwise none is.

| Hypothetical denial answering the original claim (line of 30 units) | Denied units |
|---|---|
| PR-204 | 30 |
| CO-197; the line's grant ended before the ship date | 30 |
| CO-197; the line's grant began after the ship date | 30 |
| CO-197; the line's grant covered the ship date | none |
| CO-50 | none |

## C. Supported charge and reversal

- **Standard computation.** In the standard computation the reviewed charge has no supported part and the reversal is the charge's open amount.
- **Combination.** Any adjustment to the supported charge changes it as that adjustment states: replacements first, then the amounts taken off, never below zero, then the percentage reductions, which add together and are taken once from the supported charge; the supported charge is rounded half up to the cent, and the reversal is the charge's open amount less the supported charge, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Standard computation worked through (hypothetical)

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Largest non-covered item charge | $102.75 |
| Billing corrections and hardship waivers already against it | $20.00 |
| Open amount | $82.75 |
| Reversal | $82.75 |
